Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

bdhs 0.1.0

  • First release. Covers all nine BDHS rounds (1993-94 to 2022), the three Bangladesh Service Provision Assessments and the 2001 maternal mortality survey.
  • Bundled data: official DHS estimates for Bangladesh (bdhs_indicators), indicator definitions, survey and dataset catalogues, cross-round codebooks, division crosswalks, pooling populations and division boundaries.
  • Microdata access for registered DHS users: bdhs_import(), bdhs_read(), bdhs_inventory() and an experimental bdhs_download().
  • Analysis: bdhs_harmonize(), bdhs_design(), bdhs_pool(), bdhs_merge(), bdhs_estimate(), bdhs_fertility(), bdhs_mortality() and bdhs_validate().
  • Synthetic data for teaching and testing: bdhs_simulate().
  • Safety: microdata file types can never enter the built package (also checked in CI); renamed files must be confirmed by their contents and name/content conflicts are refused; the DHS password is only ever sent to https://dhsprogram.com and never kept after a failed login; imports lock the data store, so concurrent sessions cannot lose files.
  • Validated statistics: child marriage by subgroup, GFR (births to mothers under 15), all-woman factors for harmonized grouping variables and the 2017-18 MR vaccine all reproduce the official DHS values. Exclusive breastfeeding leaves out country-specific liquids, as in the DHS standard definition (2007: 49.8%, official 49.8%); 353 of 355 national comparisons now match.
  • data-raw/00-rebuild-from-local.R rebuilds codebooks and the validation record from new DHS downloads (zips included) in one command.

Developed by Arman Hossen.

Site built with pkgdown 2.2.1.
